_doc: Mutation refinery operations (money sinks that work on items in the backpack or on the base). Cost = rollCost * costMult * (1 + 0.5 * mutationCount). Placed 'refiner' flow items live in items.json. Add an operation by adding it here and a handler in sim/refiners.js.

reroll.name: Re-roll mutations
reroll.desc: Discard all mutations and roll new ones (boosted odds). Can come out worse.

transfer.name: Transfer a mutation
transfer.desc: Move one mutation from a donor item to a target item (needs a free slot and a free group).

combine.name: Combine mutations
combine.desc: Both items carry the same mutation: target's level +1. On failure the donor loses it, the target is unchanged.
